reviews.t: This was a good product! Finally a highlighter that works well with ...
reviews.x: This was a good product! Finally a highlighter that works well with my dark skin tone. You can add as much darkness of the product you want, because it starts off as a sheer tint of white highlight and it's easy to apply. However, I wish it was easier to apply with a makeup brush rather than the tube appliance it's self. It was a bit smaller than I had in mind, but I know it will last a while! It looks like a shimmery pink when opened, but once applied you can see it isn't. In the photos I've pr

Love it! I just bought two more before the seller raises the price. Super happy with this stuff, smooth finish, not glittery or chunky, subtle yet glamorous and SUPER affordable. I'm very happy with my purchase!

reviews.t: It actually smells really good, slightly perfumy
reviews.x: Im asian so my skintone isn't too dark and the highlighter definitely showed up bright. You really won't need a lot. The first layer that you apply after opening it look cakey but if you blend it in it'll stay on creamy. It actually smells really good, slightly perfumy...like a flower? But after you apply it on your face you hardly smell it, its only inside the tube that is strong enough to be scented.

reviews.t: I have a glow that I never had before and I am 82 years .
reviews.x: Gives you that glow like you see in movies and on T.V Just do not over do it.

I liked the glow it had on my arm when I tested it but when I tried it on my face it would not appear, and it felt tacky. On top of that, it was kind of hard to blend. I do however, like the subtle smell it has to it, it smells like lemons :) I will be using this as a base for other highlighters because I feel this has potential to do so, I just won't be using it alone.

I liked the color and shine but the texture was terrible and it was extremely hard to blend and when it finally blended, ythe he color wasn't vibrant or shiny at all. I suggest you invest in a powder highlighter instead. Don't even waste your money. I will not be using this, will probably go in the trash.

reviews.t: Super great to use just kinda awkward to apply - ...
reviews.x: Super great to use just kinda awkward to apply - Applies from the stick onto the face but then you have to blend it around and it's kinda sticky when you first put it on. If you do not blend it in, you have an actual line of highlighter!

reviews.t: The color is beautiful and stays on about half the day before you ...
reviews.x: The color is beautiful and stays on about half the day before you need to reapply. The only reason I gave it four stars is because the application sucks. You need to apply so much for it to show up that it almost looks cakey and risks messing up your foundation. Once you get down your technique for application it works great for a beginner. Remember you get what you pay for.
wouldn't recommend, doesn't apply nicely on top of foundation

reviews.t: I like this product because it's creamy and you can always ...
reviews.x: I like this product because it's creamy and you can always apply more product and work with it. You can also put a powdery highlighter on top of it to give it more pop but alone works great. If you use a beauty blender whether it's wet or dry it consumes most ally all of the product so you can apply it with your fingertips or a brush to get more product on your face. I really love it and do recomend it, it's small but a little always goes a long way.

reviews.t: Looks nice, but not for daily use.
reviews.x: I really love the color and texture of this product. It doesn't stay one all day and needs reapplied but I didn't really mind because of the price. However, I used this product almost every day for almost two weeks and my skin started getting super dry where I applied it every day, so I've stopped using it. After my skin gets back to normal, though, I think I'll use it every few days. I wouldn't recommend this product to people with sensitive skin.

reviews.t: ... body but on my face it also made every fine line appear more pronounced
reviews.x: It was too light in the silver even for my porcelain white skin but it is a creamy product and highlights without being too sparkly so may use it on my body but on my face it also made every fine line appear more pronounced. I wanted the gold shade and was not available. Also the product I had 2 apply with a sponge as it would not stay up to roll directly on the skin. Would not buy again

Definitely recommend and will continue to buy! Arrived early, I accidentally ordered the wrong color, they were awesome and switched it out for me! The highlighter itself (gold) is very versatile! Has a decent amount of shimmer that catches the light without being too much for day wear, and of course if you use extra, the shimmer is perfect for a night out!

I can't believe this item for the price! It works as well as High Beam by a high end company and I just love it. It goes on smooth and stays put all day.  The color is perfect for my skin and I think it would compliment many skin tones, darker or lighter. Plus the amount you get will last forever!

Great product highlighter with shimmer....may need a good foundation base underneath....it does feel cool to my skin but my skin feels a bit more dry.  I do like look...but prefer my skin soft and supple.
The pigment is very light, but it has a HORRIBLE smell. I'm always willing to try anything when it comes to makeup, but the smell is so bad that I can't use it
Really hard to apply. While applying it removes all other make up
It's very nice! I have super dry skin so the consistency is perfect. I'm fairly tan (of south Asian descent) and my aunt is very pale and we can both use the product and we blend it out to our liking
My first highlighter. It's soooo light on my cheeks but I do use it on my shins and down the length of my nose. It works if you just want a hint of highlight and not the "Glam Look."
I love the product. It was very easy to apply. I would recommend not putting too much on at first, which means it will last a long time. Overall, great product!!

reviews.t: Otherwise very nice, cute and a little pinkish tone
reviews.x: You definitely have to use this product lightly don't press too hard when you use it. Otherwise very nice, cute and a little pinkish tone!
This is beautiful and can be users for so much more than highlights. My daughter loves it as eyeshadow

reviews.t: Great product. Smaller than I thought it would be ...
reviews.x: Arrived 3 days early. Great product. Smaller than I thought it would be but nevertheless satisfied.
I love this highlighter.  It stays on and shines perfectly. I will DEFINATELY buy again

reviews.t: it would probably be great if it weren't so oily and just smeared
reviews.x: Too oily. it would probably be  great if it weren't so oily and just smeared everywhere

claims.text: Many reviewers love the glow and shimmer, calling it smooth, subtle yet glamorous, and comparable to high-end highlighters.
Several reviewers find it hard or awkward to apply and blend, with some saying it looks cakey or tacky.
Some reviewers note it doesn't last all day and needs reapplying.
A few reviewers mention it can dry out the skin or emphasize fine lines.
Reviewers praise the pleasant, subtle scent.
